newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- A front page commentary calls for thorough study and implementation of the Basic Law to ensure Hong Kong's smooth transition and future stability and prosperity.
- President Jiang Zemin meets visiting Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh, saying China and Thailand can develop good-neighbourly, cooperative relations marked by mutual trust.
- The central bank issues rules to tighten management of cash in commercial banks.
- Sichuan Leshan Electric Power Co is to buy 9.9 million yuan worth of shares of the Leshan Cooperative Bank.
- The Shanghai city government plans to issue 500 million yuan worth of three-year bonds from April 8 to April 28, with the proceeds to be used for infrastructure construction.
- Chinese meteorologists say cold and wet weather in southern China poses a threat to rice and rapeseed crops.
- The China Construction Bank launches a $200 million floating rate note issue bond-style in Hong Kong.
- The State Planning Commission sets prices on imported urea at 1,900 yuan a tonne for the first six months of 1997.
